name: Spades
subtitle: Partnership trick-taking
description: Bid Nil or 1–13 tricks, follow suit, and use spades as trump. Play with a computer partner against two opponents; score contracts and bags to reach 500 points.

name: Tonk
subtitle: Draw, discard, and knock
description: Play five-card Tonk against a computer. Draw from stock or discard, make sets and suited runs, lay off cards, and knock at any point total on your turn.

name: Dominoes
subtitle: Match your tiles
description: Play a four-player double-six block game. Match either open end of the chain, pass when blocked, and aim to empty your hand or finish with the lowest pip count.

name: Chess
subtitle: Outsmart the computer
description: Play chess against a local computer opponent with legal moves, castling, en passant and promotion. Checkmate the opposing king to win.

name: Checkers
subtitle: Jump to victory
description: Play checkers against a computer. Move diagonally, obey mandatory captures, chain jumps, and crown kings when pieces reach the far side.

name: Backgammon
subtitle: Race your checkers home
description: Roll dice, move all 15 checkers toward home, hit opposing blots, re-enter from the bar and bear off. Play against a computer without a doubling cube.

name: Chinese Checkers
subtitle: Race across the star board
description: Move ten checkers across a 121-hole star board. Make adjacent moves or chain jumps over pieces to fill the opposite triangle before the computer.

name: Hearts
subtitle: Avoid the penalty cards
description: Play four-player Hearts against three computer opponents. Pass three cards, follow suit, avoid hearts and the queen of spades, or shoot the moon.

name: Solitaire
subtitle: Klondike card puzzle
description: Play draw-one Klondike Solitaire. Move alternating-color descending stacks in the tableau and build four suited foundations from ace to king.

name: Blackjack
subtitle: Beat the dealer without busting
description: Play with virtual chips against a computer dealer. Hit or stand to approach 21 without busting; natural blackjack pays 3:2. No real-money betting.

name: Uno
subtitle: Match colors and numbers
description: Play four-player Uno against three computer opponents. Match colors and numbers, reverse direction, skip players, use draw and wild cards, and empty your hand first.

name: Go Fish
subtitle: Ask, collect, and make books
description: Ask a computer opponent for ranks you already hold, draw when unsuccessful, and collect complete four-card books to win.

name: Yahtzee
subtitle: Roll for the highest score
description: Roll five dice up to three times per turn, hold useful dice, and fill thirteen scoring categories. Reach 63 upper-section points for a bonus.

name: Tic-Tac-Toe
subtitle: Classic three-in-a-row
description: Play X against a computer on a three-by-three board. Choose Easy, Medium or Hard difficulty and make three in a row to win.

name: Connect Four
subtitle: Four in a row
description: Drop discs into seven columns against the computer. Connect four horizontally, vertically or diagonally while blocking your rival.

name: Reversi
subtitle: Flip your rival’s discs
description: Place discs on an eight-by-eight board, sandwich and flip opposing discs, and finish with the majority. Pass when no legal move is available.

name: Gin Rummy
subtitle: Meld, knock and go Gin
description: Draw and discard against a computer, assemble sets or runs, reduce deadwood, knock at ten or fewer points, or go Gin with zero.

name: Euchre
subtitle: Tricks, trump, and teamwork
description: Play with a computer partner in a four-player, 24-card game. Bid on trump, use the right and left bowers, and win at least three of five tricks.

name: Cribbage
subtitle: Peg your way to 121
description: Discard two cards to the crib, peg toward 31, and score combinations of fifteens, pairs, runs, flushes and nobs. Race the computer to 121.

name: Battleship
subtitle: Find and sink the fleet
description: Target a concealed ten-by-ten grid and sink five computer ships before your own randomly placed fleet is destroyed.

name: Mancala
subtitle: Sow, capture, and score
description: Play Kalah against the computer. Sow stones, capture opposite pits, earn extra turns by landing in your store, and collect the most stones.

name: Farkle
subtitle: Push your luck with dice
description: Roll six dice, keep scoring combinations, and choose whether to bank points or risk another roll. Race a computer opponent to 10,000.

name: Sudoku
subtitle: Five levels of number puzzles
description: Solve unique 9×9 Sudoku puzzles in Easy, Medium, Hard, Mensa and Ridiculous tiers. Fill every row, column and 3×3 box with digits 1–9. Use pencil marks, hints, daily challenges and offline saves.

name: Sum Logic
subtitle: Circle numbers to match target sums
description: Solve number sum puzzles by circling or erasing numbers to match row and column targets. Five difficulty levels from Easy to Ridiculous, with extra region targets on larger boards, daily puzzles, hints and offline progress.

name: Wordle
subtitle: Guess the five-letter word
description: Guess a hidden five-letter word in six attempts with position and letter feedback. Play random and daily puzzles offline using a bundled word list.

name: Spider Solitaire
subtitle: Complete eight descending runs
description: Play one-, two- or four-suit Spider Solitaire. Build suited king-to-ace runs, move legal stacks, and clear eight sequences. Drag cards or tap, undo moves, and play offline.

name: FreeCell Solitaire
subtitle: Four free cells, one clever solution
description: Play FreeCell Solitaire with four free cells, eight tableau columns and four foundations. Move alternating-color descending stacks within legal capacity and build ace-to-king foundations. Tap or drag cards and undo mistakes.

name: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe
subtitle: Nine boards, one strategic battle
description: Play the ultimate nine-board Tic-Tac-Toe against an offline computer opponent. Each move sends your opponent to a specific mini-board. Win three mini-boards in a row to win the match.

name: Snake
subtitle: Eat, grow, survive
description: Classic offline Snake with keyboard, swipe and on-screen controls. Eat food, avoid walls and your own tail, and beat your high score.
